metadata.title: Assai Product Delivery and Deployment
metadata.description: Proposed deployment model based on published SaaS, browser and integration context. Runtime channels are logical boundaries; vendors, regions, license rules, SLAs and physical topology are unverified. MVP and offer sequencing are in _domain/DOMAIN.md.

channels.description: Proposed SaaS responsibility boundaries, not verified cloud accounts or provider regions. DMS-specific capabilities are optional sources for Viewport and Enterprise.
DMS document, review, supplier and handover processing. No physical deployment or vendor technology is asserted.
